summary: ResolveWave is a cloud contact-center platform serving SMB and mid-market customers. Primary objective: reduce live-agent volume via high-throughput chat deflection (bot-first), while keeping agent-assist quality high for escalations. Extremely cost-sensitive at scale; current infra costs from existing vendor rising with conversational token volume. Interested in Redwood Dedicated + Optimize to control unit economics; VPC + SOC2/KMS required for customer contracts.
performance_targets: p95 generation latency <300ms for agent-assist workflows; sustained baseline 600 req/s for chat-deflection with spikes to 2000 req/s during promos; target 60% deflection rate within 3 months of rollout.
cost_targets: Target unit cost < $0.003 per response-token-equivalent for high-volume deflection; pilot budget cap ~$40k/month; long-term ARR target in range above.
